newsitem.title: USA: Alza files to distribute Crescendo shares.
newsitem.headline: Alza files to distribute Crescendo shares.

text.p: Alza Corp said Tuesday it will file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its planned distribution of Crescendo shares to Alza security holders.

If the distribution is approved by Alza's board of directors, Alza will contribute $300 million to Crescendo in exchange for its class A common stock. Alza would then distribute the Crescendo shares to Alza common stockholders and debenture holders.

However, Alza said the transaction will not be approved unless it exercises its option to buy all outstanding shares of Therapeutic Discovery Corp. It said it has not yet determined whether it will exercise the option to buy Therapeutic Discovery.
Alza said it formed Crescendo for the purpose of selecting and developing human pharmaceuticals products for commercialization.

If the distribution of Crescendo shares occurs, it said Crescendo would continue the development of a number of products initially developed by Alza and Therapeutic Discovery. Alza would have the option to license each Crescendo product and an option to buy all of the Crescendo shares at a price based on a predetermined formula.
